remarks.role: achieve ambition with intentionality, intensity, integrity & insanity.
remarks.text:
among ai leaders i seem to be in the minority in that i am STILL actively using /loop and /goal....

... and i think all of u guys who stopped using it are wrong - not wrong forever, just giving up on it too early in the g5.6/c5 era

now you use it when:
1) you want the right mix of steerability and autonomy
2) you want open ended "loop that generates loops" type end state without deeply specifying path to get there

heres an example of when having a goal on saved my ass in a very long action-reasonining turn
remarks.translation: 在AI领域的领军人物中，我似乎是少数派——因为我仍然在积极使用/loop和/goal……而且我觉得你们这些放弃使用它们的人都错了——不是永远错，只是在这个g5.6/c5时代过早地放弃了。现在你会在以下情况使用它：1）当你想要可操控性与自主性的正确结合时；2）当你想要开放式“循环生成循环”式的最终状态，而不需要深入指定达成路径时。这里有一个例子，说明在很长的行动-推理回合中，设置一个目标是如何救了我的命的。

remarks.name: Aaron Levie
remarks.role: ceo box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
remarks.text:
No idea if these specific numbers generalize across tasks, but directionally it’s clear that the harness is going to become the most important variable -right next to model capability- in the AI stack. 

The ability for harnesses to break down work in the most efficient way and route to the right model at the right time is going to be a huge variable for maximizing accuracy and reducing costs.

We’re actually still incredibly early in this journey. The harness didn’t matter that much when tasks only took hundreds of thousands or millions of tokens. But as we have tasks that take tens of millions and hundreds of millions of tokens, this becomes a major variable. Huge opportunity ahead.
remarks.translation: 不确定这些具体数字能否推广到所有任务，但从方向上看，很明显，调度框架将成为AI技术栈中最重要的变量——其重要性仅次于模型能力。调度框架能否以最高效的方式拆解工作，并在恰当时机调用合适的模型，将成为提升准确率、降低成本的关键变量。事实上，我们在这条路上仍处于极早期阶段。当任务仅需数十万或数百万token时，调度框架的重要性并不突出。但随着任务规模达到数千万乃至数亿token，它就成了一个重大变量。前方蕴藏着巨大机遇。

remarks.name: Nan Yu
remarks.role: head of product linear
remarks.text:
The most common loop written in Linear is some variant this one (Issue > Agent > PR > Release) 

~30% of our bugs make it all the way through this flow.

But there are some nuances to doing it -- The instructions should ask the agent to extensively research the root cause of the issue and to use Datadog and Sentry MCPs to gather more evidence.

It should only attempt to provide a fix if there's high certainty, otherwise you end up burning a lot of tokens.

If it thinks that more evidence would help it during its research, like asking the reporter to provide repro steps, etc, it should leave a comment on the issue requesting it.

Agents need to be told to following good practices, just like people!
remarks.translation: Linear 中最常见的循环是这种变体（问题 > 代理 > PR > 发布），大约 30% 的缺陷会完整走完这个流程。但实际操作中有一些细微之处——指令应要求代理深入调查问题的根本原因，并使用 Datadog 和 Sentry MCP 收集更多证据。只有在高度确定的情况下才应尝试提供修复方案，否则会消耗大量 token。如果在研究过程中认为更多证据会有帮助，比如请报告者提供复现步骤等，代理应在问题上留言请求。代理也需要被教导遵循良好实践，就像人一样！
